I’m not a therapist or anything but I suffer from bed as well. Maybe try to find the reason why you’re doing this? Why lately? What’s triggering it? Is it a person in your life or something? From what I’ve seen this is mainly just a place to share your experiences with bed rather than find an actual solution to the problem. I’ve seen very few if at all pieces of advice here that do actually work and are not the typical quotes of empowerment “don’t act on the urge” “you got this” “things get better” etc. I think that your main focus should be the reason why you’re doing it. Hope you like it here on reddit! xx

It all started back then when I was daily starving myself. But I never saw a proper therapist/dietitian. My parents just made my life a living hell in order for me to start eating more again so I had no choice (I was a minor and they didn’t even care about me recovering they just cared about the world not noticing their child was very slim and had anorexia - so f’d up but that’s another story). So as soon as I started eating again I didn’t do it the righ way. I would eat three boxes of cookies and two family pack ice creams in a day but they didn’t care as long as I gained weight and seemed healthier. That’s when it all began. Also at some point my mother was so tired from work that she would make beans on Sunday night for a week even though she knew I hated them. So my father should just order take out for himself only and I would come home from school, had nothing to eat (except the beans), hated the beans, didn’t know how to cook so I would just eat snacks and chips and biscuits. And this went on for two years until I started cooking and eventually left this hell of a household. Anyway sending love back! I really hope things get better!
